verdict.rationale: Stripe's own payment surfaces, such as Payment Links, feed transactions into Stripe Tax without code. Payments processed outside Stripe are supported, but only through the standalone Tax Calculations/Transactions APIs, which means building the plumbing yourself. The TaxJar integration covers filing, not transaction ingestion. Missing for 10: maintained connectors for third-party billing systems, other payment processors, and commerce platforms (e.g., storefront plugins), plus independent corroboration of any such integrations.
